rows.quote: With respect to GWAS data for the AVB outcome, we retrieved GWAS data from UkBiobank (https://pheweb.org/UKB-TOPMed/pheno/426.24/).
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives the outcome GWAS as retrieved from pheweb.org/UKB-TOPMed (phenotype 426.24), the web resource that is the source identifier of the UKB-TOPMed PheWeb row alone; the next sentence's 586 cases and 379,215 controls fall inside that row's per-code ranges, no conflict.
